purpose: Continue a retained test-only research patch after pristine baseline and scoped checks, without treating it as an approved fix.

execution.instructions: The declared prior_patch file is unreviewed read-only reference data, not a workspace seed or an accepted review. After reading pristine baseline/checks, reuse its test-only changes with apply_patch in this ordinary edit turn; preserve existing findings and avoid broad rewrite. If contexts/base differ, stop rather than force or rebase. Do not normalize or adopt the failed review. Research evidence only; no engine optimization or product-fix claim. Follow request, AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Read full baseline, scoped checks and measurement artifacts, including exact selected test/package outcomes. Baseline stdout must cover the original six controls; baseline collector sidecars are not required. Candidate structured evidence remains mandatory. Change only test-side collectors/regressions and concise research findings; preserve production algorithms, RNG/order, pruning, grading, identities, validation, work/cancellation limits and the single 10-second request deadline. Preserve existing release tests/benchmarks and all six controls. Require fresh engine/generator per sample, no cache hits, actual nonzero bounded work and one deadline across seed rounds; distinguish native work from total request work. Add the separately selected opt-in research benchmark. Record expected bounded rejection/deadline/not-reproduced outcomes as complete structured JSON DATA; broken setup, invariants or incomplete collection remain failures. Missing sidecars or truncated stdout are incomplete evidence. Configured steps execute checks/measurement; do not run them, Git, agents or external work. Use the deadline; hand off a runnable collector before drawing conclusions. Material scope/capability blockers return blocked. Keep summary <=240 characters; no workflow, permission or limit changes.
